threadTitle: How do you build a work capsule when nothing fits the same?
opText: I keep buying pieces that don't work together. Looking for a simple system, not brand recs.
genDraft: For "How do you build a work capsule when nothing fits the same?": pick one versatile base layer and build two outfits around it before buying more. Skip trends that need three new SKUs.
ceDraft: Start with one neutral base layer that already fits, then force the next two pieces to work with it before you buy anything else. Brand lists can wait until the system is clear.

threadTitle: Is color analysis worth it or just TikTok fluff?
opText: Curious if anyone actually uses season analysis to shop, or if I should ignore it.
genDraft: For "Is color analysis worth it or just TikTok fluff?": pick one versatile base layer and build two outfits around it before buying more. Skip trends that need three new SKUs.
ceDraft: Treat season labels as an optional filter, not a religion — if neutrals already work on you, skip the quiz and buy for fit first.
